commits: Package commit (check-budgets, contract-pins), conventional, empty scope, chore:, no attribution.
acceptance: make check passes and check-budgets reads a seeded ceiling for each of ui, cards, charts, data, router, table
each ceiling equals the first-build measurement plus 5 percent rounded up to 0.5 KB, the one formula (the PR lists measured and seeded values)
